description: Figure 5 presents an error analysis comparing a Vanilla model and a HCL model, visualized as two adjacent pie charts. The chart consists of two pie charts, one for each model, each divided into three slices representing error categories. For the Vanilla model, the slices are labeled “Skill Fail” (light orange, approximately 68.6%), “Reason Error” (dark orange, approximately 21.6%), and “Question Misunderstood” (light red, approximately 9.8%). For the HCL model, the slices are labeled “Skill Fail” (light blue, approximately 55.0%), “Reason Error” (dark blue, approximately 14.0%), and “Question Misunderstood” (light purple, approximately 30.0%). Percentage labels are displayed inside each slice. A legend is included to correlate colors with error types.
